name: svczz-watchlist
description: SVCZZ's MCP server for movies and series: find something from a description, see where it streams in your country, and, once you connect your SVCZZ account, read and update your watch list, lists and progress. Plus skills that build on it: what to watch tonight, catch up on your shows, picks from what you liked, a weekly what's new, a year in review, a movie night planner, and importing or tidying your lists.
